doctrine.commit_derivation: git rev-parse origin/main in the live builders-doctrine checkout inspected in the re-pin session (local HEAD identical, working tree clean); not copied from any other product's binding.

candidate_register._why: Central Doctrine authority per the Doctrine README; every artifact named here is validated by doctrine_bootstrap.py (trial defect B6).

bootstrap._why: The orientation executable itself. scripts/doctrine-orient.py fingerprints this file against the value below BEFORE executing it, so a tampered copy on the pinned commit cannot forge a VALID receipt.

version_manifest._why: The Doctrine's own declaration of version, status and core fingerprints. Pinned so the version and status inspected at binding (1.1.0, ACTIVE_PENDING_REPIN) cannot drift silently; scripts/doctrine-orient.py cross-checks it against the disk and this binding and refuses a contradiction.

ux_design_assurance_manifest._why: The Gallery is governed by Playbook Stage 2A and Audit Protocol §11, which invoke the ux-design-assurance module. This manifest carries the SHA-256 and byte count of each of the module's 19 other files; scripts/doctrine-orient.py expands and verifies that list at orientation (derived, never hand-listed), so the whole module is fingerprint-checked without a hand-maintained copy of the manifest here.

ux-design-assurance.verification: manifest expansion by scripts/doctrine-orient.py at every orient/check

bound_by.decision_source: The governor's session instruction of 2026-11-05: "Could we re pin the new builders doctrine to this?" Discharges the activation of OBL-GAL-004 after builders-doctrine main advanced dfdecb651df8 -> 6dc016c485ec (21 commits; pinned artefacts changed: DOCTRINE_CANDIDATE_REGISTER.csv +C-0014..C-0017 and VERSION.json register fingerprint; Canon, Playbook, Audit Protocol, bootstrap and ux-design-assurance manifest byte-identical).

repin_rule: This binding pins a commit. Any advance of builders-doctrine's default branch makes it stale and orientation refuses until it is re-pinned in a governed change that re-derives every fingerprint (Doctrine VERSION.json freeze_note; product obligation OBL-GAL-004).
